<documents>
<document id="support-no-advice">
FinancialˆadviceˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆcanˆexplainˆhowˆTallowbrookˆproductsˆwork,ˆbutˆweˆcan'tˆgiveˆfinancial,ˆinvestment,ˆtaxˆorˆlegalˆadvice.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcan'tˆhelpˆwithˆ-ˆWhetherˆtoˆinvest,ˆsaveˆorˆpayˆdownˆdebtˆ-ˆWhichˆstocks,ˆfundsˆorˆcryptocurrenciesˆtoˆbuyˆorˆsellˆ-ˆHowˆmuchˆofˆyourˆmoneyˆtoˆkeepˆinˆsavingsˆ-ˆHowˆtoˆreportˆinterestˆorˆotherˆincomeˆonˆyourˆtaxesˆ-ˆLegalˆquestionsˆaboutˆwills,ˆdivorceˆorˆdisputesˆwithˆotherˆpeopleˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcanˆhelpˆwithˆ-ˆHowˆourˆsavingsˆratesˆandˆSavingsˆPocketsˆworkˆ-ˆFeesˆandˆlimitsˆonˆeachˆplan,ˆsoˆyouˆcanˆdecideˆwhichˆsuitsˆyouˆ-ˆYourˆstatementsˆandˆtaxˆformsˆ##ˆWhereˆtoˆgetˆadviceˆForˆadviceˆaboutˆyourˆsituation,ˆtalkˆtoˆaˆqualifiedˆfinancialˆadviser,ˆtaxˆprofessionalˆorˆlawyer.ˆ##ˆInvestingˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆofferˆinvestmentˆorˆbrokerageˆaccounts.ˆSeeˆ"Investingˆandˆcryptocurrency".ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="support-what-we-can-do">
WhatˆourˆsupportˆteamˆcanˆhelpˆwithˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆcanˆsortˆoutˆmostˆthingsˆduringˆyourˆchat.ˆSomeˆrequestsˆgoˆtoˆaˆspecialistˆteam,ˆandˆaˆfewˆthingsˆweˆcan'tˆdoˆatˆall.ˆ##ˆSupportˆcanˆ-ˆFreezeˆorˆunfreezeˆyourˆcardˆ-ˆReportˆaˆcardˆlostˆorˆstolenˆandˆorderˆaˆreplacementˆ-ˆOpenˆaˆdisputeˆthat'sˆinsideˆitsˆwindow,ˆhasˆposted,ˆandˆtotalsˆupˆtoˆ$5,000ˆ-ˆRefundˆaˆfeeˆunderˆourˆrefundˆpolicyˆ-ˆChangeˆyourˆplanˆ-ˆCloseˆyourˆaccountˆifˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆzeroˆandˆnothingˆisˆpendingˆorˆdisputedˆ-ˆExplainˆfees,ˆlimitsˆandˆpoliciesˆ##ˆSupportˆpassesˆtoˆaˆspecialistˆteamˆ-ˆ**Fraud:**ˆsuspectedˆaccountˆtakeover,ˆremovingˆaˆfraudˆlock,ˆscamˆpaymentsˆ-ˆ**Disputes:**ˆdisputesˆaboveˆtheˆsupportˆlimitˆ-ˆ**Verification:**ˆidentityˆchecks,ˆlegalˆnameˆorˆdate-of-birthˆchanges,ˆaccountsˆunderˆreviewˆorˆrestrictedˆ-ˆ**AccountˆServices:**ˆpowerˆofˆattorney,ˆaˆdeceasedˆaccountˆholder,ˆfinancialˆabuseˆ-ˆ**Complaints:**ˆformalˆcomplaintsˆSpecialistˆteamsˆreplyˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆSupportˆcan'tˆ-ˆActˆfor,ˆorˆshareˆdetailsˆwith,ˆanyoneˆotherˆthanˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆ-ˆGiveˆinvestment,ˆtaxˆorˆlegalˆadviceˆ-ˆRaiseˆlimitsˆ-ˆRefundˆfeesˆoutsideˆtheˆrefundˆpolicy,ˆorˆopenˆdisputesˆafterˆtheirˆwindowˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="savings-tax-forms">
TaxˆformsˆforˆinterestˆIfˆyouˆearnˆatˆleastˆ$10.00ˆinˆinterestˆduringˆaˆcalendarˆyear,ˆweˆsendˆyouˆaˆFormˆ1099-INT.ˆ##ˆWhenˆit'sˆavailableˆByˆJanuaryˆ31ˆofˆtheˆfollowingˆyear.ˆYou'llˆfindˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆDocuments,ˆthenˆTaxˆforms.ˆWe'llˆnotifyˆyouˆwhenˆit'sˆready.ˆ##ˆEarnedˆless?ˆIfˆyouˆearnedˆlessˆthanˆtheˆthreshold,ˆweˆdon'tˆsendˆaˆform,ˆbutˆtheˆinterestˆisˆstillˆshownˆonˆyourˆmonthlyˆstatements.ˆYouˆmayˆstillˆneedˆtoˆreportˆit.ˆ##ˆPremiumˆATMˆsurchargeˆrefundsˆandˆbonusesˆATMˆsurchargeˆrefundsˆaren'tˆinterestˆandˆdon'tˆappearˆonˆtheˆform.ˆReferralˆbonusesˆmayˆbeˆreportedˆseparately.ˆ##ˆTaxˆquestionsˆWeˆcan'tˆgiveˆtaxˆadvice.ˆForˆquestionsˆaboutˆhowˆtoˆreportˆinterest,ˆtalkˆtoˆaˆtaxˆprofessional.ˆ##ˆWrongˆdetailsˆonˆtheˆformˆIfˆyourˆnameˆorˆtaxpayerˆIDˆonˆtheˆformˆisˆwrong,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆChangesˆtoˆyourˆlegalˆnameˆorˆtaxpayerˆIDˆgoˆtoˆourˆVerificationˆteam.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: What stock should I buy with my tax refund?
